decision: Full car = 'gt3 rs Full Car.stl' (25M tris), levelled with tools/level.py (ground RANSAC, 3.4 deg tilt; long axis -> Y, front = -Y), decimated 4 mm (wide) and 2.5 mm (close-ups), cropped, prepped -> car4.json; every part prepped --like car4.json
why: Raw frame had the ground tilted 3.4 deg and the car diagonal; one rigid transform (level.json) applied to every part keeps all Artec exports registered

decision: Parts registered at identity (red-over-grey renders + nearest-surface d50 2.4-7 mm): fender vent, front bumper strakes, front grille trim, front lower lip, hood vent top (warped) + interface assembled (left), rear bumper, rear bumper strake, rear diffuser 1/2, diffuser trim inner/outer, rear QP intakes 1/2, side skirt strake, side skirt upper/lower
why: Lesson: check each part over the car by rendering and looking; all z-fight with the car skin

decision: Not used: 'Porsche 911 GT3 (992) Rear Diffuser.stl', hood vent interface right/no fins, hood vent fins, Alex's Full Assembly.blend
why: 992 diffuser sits 350 mm off in another frame and is named for the non-RS GT3 (user: our scan data only); interface right/no-fins and fins sit centred under the hood in their own frame (nothing visible over the car); the 4.6 GB .blend is an assembly, not a scan state

decision: No hood/trunk/door/DRS opening beat from state scans
why: Folder has no hood/trunk/door states; Underbody 'DRS Open Rear' ICP-registered to the car differs from the closed car by <8 mm on the wing profile (no flap rotation visible) - the brief says open panels only where the state scans allow

decision: Shot order: s1 low front-left 3/4 turntable -> s2 rear-right 3/4 orbit (swan-neck wing, diffuser) -> s3 front-left wheel/brake close-up (2.5 mm) -> s4 right fender louvres close-up -> s5 swan-neck wing mounts from high behind -> s6 nose aero lifts off (lip, strakes, grille trim, left hood-vent top) -> s7 high front 3/4 up to top-down -> s8 aero explode/reassemble -> logo
why: Brief's Temerario order; s6 stands in for 'panels open' with scanned parts because no hood/trunk/door/DRS-open state exists

decision: Explode = 13 aero part scans over comp_explode4 (full car with each part's skin cut within 9 mm, tools/composite.py, no fills): lip, grille trim, front strakes, fender vent, left hood-vent top, side skirt upper/lower/strake, both QP intakes, rear bumper strake, rear diffuser, diffuser trim outer
why: Brief: aero pieces off the body is the hero beat; no 'removed' state scans exist for this car, so the base is the full car trimmed back, which leaves only small cut-outs under thin aero pieces

decision: Hood vent interface (assembled, left) stays on the car in s6/s8 instead of moving
why: In the first preview it rose as a tall bracket-like piece that does not read as a body part

decision: Fender vent stays on the car in s6 (moves only in the explode)
why: Preview: cutting it out leaves a ragged hole on the right fender in full view of the s6 camera

decision: Framing tightened after 30 % previews: s1 radius 5.4->4.9, angles 38-72 -> 24-52; s2 -150..-122 -> -158..-134; explode radius 7.0 -> 5.2-5.6 with camera 4.2-4.6 m high, orbit 48 -> -36 deg
why: Contact sheets: car read small in 9:16 and side-on ends cropped the nose; higher explode camera lays the car's length along the frame height

decision: Side skirts used uncleaned; rear diffuser keeps its undertray
why: Distance-to-car cleaning (100 mm) would have deleted the skirts' inner flanges and the diffuser undertray, which are real part surfaces the car scan never saw
